prompt: Explain why day and night alternate on Earth. Give three connected sentences.
reference: Earth rotation, illuminated side and dark side
response:
Day and night alternate on Earth because of the planet's rotation. The Earth rotates on its axis, causing one hemisphere to face away from the Sun while the other faces towards it. This causes the same side of the Earth to receive sunlight during the day and the opposite side to receive darkness at night.

Additionally, the tilt of the Earth's rotational axis also affects the amount of daylight received throughout the year. During summer, when the Earth is tilted closer to the Sun, more days have longer hours of daylight than those with shorter nights. Conversely, in winter, when the Earth is tilted farther away from the Sun, there are fewer days with long daylight hours.

These factors combine to create the alternating pattern of day and night that we observe every day.
